Diego Morales: Hey team, first day here. My laptop charges through the company dock but my external LG 27 monitor shows "No Signal". Dock LED is blue. Any quick fixes? Also tracking shows monitor as 'label created', who do I ping? :wave:

IT - Ren: Welcome Diego! Quick try: unplug the display cable from the dock, reboot the dock power (unplug 10s), plug back, and in macOS System Settings > Displays hold Option and click Detect Displays. If you can, run: `system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType` and paste the small snippet.

Diego Morales: Tried rebooting dock, tried another DP cable, still nothing. system_profiler shows only the integrated GPU: `Display VendorID: 610 DisplayProductID: 820`

IT - Ren: That usually means the external isn't enumerating. Two routes: Facilities can bring a spare monitor/dock to your desk, or Logistics can confirm shipment. @People Ops - Mira, can you check the onboarding tracker?

Logistics Bot: Package RDW-992334 status: label_created, carrier=ShipQuick, last_update=2025-09-12 11:05 UTC, est_delivery=2025-09-14.

People Ops - Mira: Thanks @Diego. If Facilities can drop a spare that will unblock your setup today. @Facilities - Jade can you help?

Facilities - Jade: Yep — I can swing by with a spare Dell and a spare dock in ~25 mins. If Ren wants to be there we can swap and test quickly.

IT - Ren: I'll meet Diego at desk 7C in 30. Also Diego, please open a ticket with subject "Monitor not detected" so we can capture serials and log the faulty dock if we need an RMA.

Diego Morales: Opening ticket now. Ticket #IT-21088. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
